descs.Havana Moment-2: A street scene echoes the portrait mural on the wall. The weathered, red-brown facade carries the rough texture of time, while a silhouetted passer-by and a boy leaning against the wall interact with the street art, adding a note of poetry to an everyday moment.
descs.博物館瞬間: My 92-year-old mother was resting in her wheelchair after a long museum visit when a photographer walked by, just as a man carrying coffee came down the stairs behind them. The three figures formed a delightful composition.
descs.拾光取影: Amid the bustle of the world, I gather moving light like treasure, letting the illuminated subjects sink into deep black and keeping only graphic outlines and silhouettes. Shadows peeled from the real world become abstractions of form and a confession of everyday life.
descs.时光碎片: On the flowing street, every unrepeatable moment is a fragment shed from the river of time. Rather than recording a complete story, the photographer stoops to gather these glinting fragments of real life, in which viewers may glimpse their own relationship with time.
descs.《勤劳致富》: Taken in February 2016 in Zhongjiang County, Sichuan. Zhongjiang hand-pulled noodles have been made here since the Song Dynasty. With the permission of a middle-aged couple, I spent two days photographing the whole noodle-making process in their small workshop.
descs.市井众生相Stories of the marketplace: This group of photos captures the many faces of life in a Moroccan marketplace.
descs.冲刺: Sprinters give it everything at a school sports day.
descs.Grand Prismatic Mist: Taken at Yellowstone National Park. Five silhouetted figures, standing, walking and taking photos, line the boardwalk against a bright, steaming background, with dark woods beyond the vapor adding depth. Drawn to the moment, I pressed the shutter on my phone without hesitation.
descs.超单体: A supercell is an extreme storm system, often bringing intense lightning, hail and even tornadoes. Inside this giant, hundreds of miles wide, a cloud-to-ground lightning strike lights up the green hail core.
descs.极地亲情: In November 2019 I flew from Union Glacier to the emperor penguin colony on the Filchner Ice Shelf, south of Antarctica's Weddell Sea, and camped on the sea ice for two weeks. By day I documented chick-rearing and colony life; by night the calls of thousands of penguins echoed like music. The image captures family bonds in extreme cold.
descs.等待日出: On a winter morning in Wulanbutong, Inner Mongolia, a herder and his horses wait for the sunrise.
descs.雪夜灯光: The first snow of winter 2025 dressed Princeton University in white, turning the campus into a fairy tale. I brightened the warm lights of this symmetrical building and shifted the background to blue for a warm-cool contrast, suggesting the stories unfolding inside on a quiet snowy evening.
descs.平陋之下 起舞: Passing a corner grocery, I was stunned to see this mural: dancers beneath the humble, and vivid lives glowing in the faint light.
descs.Let the light brighten me: At dusk on a snowy evening, waiting at a traffic light, I saw a girl gazing upward where light met snow. The streetlights traced a gentle outline around her, and her breath drifted away in the cold air like an unspoken poem.
descs.敦煌秘境探幽 Meet Dunhuang: At the Dunhuang interactive center, the lamp in a girl's hand lit up the whole room, linking the present with ancient times. I captured the curiosity in her eyes the instant she looked back.

descs_zh.Street musicians: 我拍下这一刻，想表现街头音乐人生活的不易：收入没有保障，工作时间又长。
descs_zh.Rhythm of Daily Life: 六个日常生活片段：背着回收物的女孩、坐在轮胎堆旁工作的年轻人、磨刀的手艺人、在门口搬椅子的妇女、在树荫下歇息的三位女士，以及喝茶时的片刻宁静。这些琐碎的劳作与温柔的瞬间，共同构成了日常生活的温度。
descs_zh.Faith Within the Smoke of Everyday Life: 西藏拉萨大昭寺前，信徒们用身体丈量信仰的距离。每一次叩拜不是对忍耐的考验，而是融入日常节奏、与自我的安静对话。在这里，虔诚不只是仪式的重复，它就是生活本身。
descs_zh.Motor Cycle Falls: 清晨，通勤者骑着摩托车涌入台北上班。
descs_zh.Viewing the World From Within: 在津巴布韦偏远的村庄 Hawange，一个小女孩从母亲食品摊的开口向外张望。
descs_zh.The Mirror of Cerro Torre: 托雷峰矗立在巴塔哥尼亚南部冰原菲茨罗伊峰以西，海拔约3100米，峰顶常覆盖着被风雕琢的雾凇，真正的峰顶极难到达。附近冰川融水形成托雷湖，山峰东壁倒映湖中。我到访时，一块形似山峰尖顶的浮冰漂过湖面，让冰、水与壮阔的山景形成了奇妙的呼应。
descs_zh.Museum Patrons: 照片中每个人都在做自己的事：聊天、看手机、阅读，或只是静坐沉思。光线照亮了人物，背景隐入暗处，营造出沉静而富有电影感的氛围。
descs_zh.Invasion of Civilization: 人类文明正在侵入野生动物的栖息地。
descs_zh.Sunrise at lake mcdonald: 冰川国家公园的魔幻时刻。
